verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an HRIS or payroll integration such as Gusto or Rippling, nor any automatic sync of new hires or terminations into equity records. Bulk spreadsheet upload and managed migrations are one-off manual data imports, not an ongoing HRIS sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
